topic.title: Smart Paste URLs over Selected Text

body.p: Copy a URL from outside the editor, for example from the address bar of a browser tab that has the Web Author 29 What's New page open.
Then select the words What's New in Web Author 29 below and paste. The selection becomes a link to the URL and keeps the selected text as the link label.
body.note: Smart paste applies to a URL copied as plain text. Content copied from inside the editor is pasted as it is.
body.p: For all the details, read What's New in Web Author 29 on the Oxygen website.
